Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering agents on real GitHub issues by requiring them to produce a patch that makes a failing test suite pass. The “Verified” subset uses tasks that have been validated as solvable and reliably testable, emphasizing end-to-end debugging, code editing, and regression-free fixes.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Self-reflection (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends the SWE-bench paradigm beyond Python to multiple programming languages and ecosystems, testing whether an agent can localize defects and implement fixes under different toolchains and language idioms. It stresses transfer of debugging and patch-construction skills across languages and project conventions.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger and harder software engineering benchmark aimed at more industrially realistic tasks and stronger contamination resistance.
